snippet.title: Friday Night MONSTER of MONSTERS: Trance Attack (FUNKKAST TRAILER)
snippet.description:
That feeling, burning you from the inside… your regrets, the mistakes you’ve made, set you into a trance. It makes you angry, doesn’t it?

It couldnt have been real... right?

INTRO song by: Hyporious
TEASER song: Exasperation by KrimsonMMV
